items.prompt: For k=2 and values [-2,-2,-3,1], what list must window_max return?

options.why: The starter expects one joined output line containing all three maxima.
That returns three lines instead of the required one joined line.
Zero is not a valid initializer for windows containing only negative observations.
The second window contains -2 and -3, whose maximum is -2.

items.explanation: The starter expects one joined output line containing all three maxima.
